BETA Close X CRH plc announced that on March 13, 2026, it purchased 73,868 of its ordinary shares in the United States through its broker, Wells Fargo Securities, LLC, as part of its share buyback program. The total value of these repurchased shares was approximately $7.37 million, with an aggregated volume-weighted average price of $99.7975 per share. These repurchased shares will be cancelled, and following these transactions, CRH plc will have 669,080,324 ordinary shares in issue, with 35,643,874 shares held in treasury. Disclaimer* 16 th March 2026 CRH plc Transaction in Own Shares CRH plc (“ CRH ”) announces that on 13 th March 2026 it acquired the following number of its ordinary shares (the “ ordinary shares ”) in the United States through CRH’s broker Wells Fargo Securities, LLC. The ordinary shares acquired (by way of redemption) will be cancelled.
